about: Two planted defects in the consumer's checks, applied only to the benchmark copy of the source: a handoff's digest is checked against itself and never against what was published; and a consumer path that only shares a prefix with a scope root is taken as inside it.

mutations.find: const within = (path, roots) => roots.some((r) => path === r || path.startsWith(`${r.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/`));
mutations.replace: const within = (path, roots) => roots.some((r) => path === r || path.startsWith(r));
